initial_goal.aim: become the greatest warrior-poet alive without submitting to another bardic examination. Find worthy rivals, oppose cruelty, learn techniques worth naming, and earn an audience that makes the guild's opinion irrelevant.
initial_goal.done: people in every known place recognize Cassian Vey's deeds and songs without asking for a bardic credential
initial_goal.why: the guild confused narrow examination rules with artistic truth, and discussing the details would only dignify its error
